guide.intro: This is a partial guide — only representative examples are shown, so you can see what sorts of sentences can be typed. Click one to watch it build, or phrase freely — if the tool didn't understand, try different wording; unsupported sentences are collected and reviewed by the project team for future support.

share.arrived: The link you opened contains a figure. Open it instead of what you built?

refusal.notUnderstood: I didn't understand the request — try rephrasing it, or open «Guide» for examples.
refusal.juxtaposedNumbers: It is not clear what «{{detail}}» means. Write {{decimal}} (a decimal), {{joined}} (one number) or {{product}} (a product).
refusal.juxtaposedNumbersProduct: It is not clear what «{{detail}}» means. If you mean a product, write {{product}}.
refusal.juxtaposedNumbersComma: It is not clear what «{{detail}}» means. If these are two numbers, separate them with a comma: {{comma}}.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedAny: All four common tangents are already drawn — two circles have no fifth common tangent.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedExternal: Both external common tangents are already drawn — two circles have no third external tangent.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedInternal: Both internal common tangents are already drawn — two circles have no third internal tangent.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedExtTangent: All three common tangents are already drawn — externally tangent circles have exactly three: two separate and one at the touch point.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedIntersecting: Both common tangents are already drawn — intersecting circles have exactly two (external).
refusal.tangentsExhaustedIntTangent: The single common tangent is already drawn — internally tangent circles have exactly one, at the touch point.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedTouchTaken: The only internal tangent — the one at the touch point — is already drawn.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedNoInternal: Circles in this configuration have no internal common tangent.
refusal.tangentsExhaustedContained: A circle contained inside another has no common tangent at all.

notice.alreadyDrawn: That's already on the figure — nothing to add.
